title: Before anything goes to Google's model
sent: To read a description, word a plan, answer a question or word a notice, this app sends Google's Gemini model the household as the form holds it: who is at home by age group, conditions as general flags such as asthma or pregnancy, and the times of the day's outings, with any question you ask.
terms: This app uses Gemini's free tier, so Google may use what is sent to improve its products, and people at Google may read it.
ask: Do not add names, record numbers or anything else that identifies a person.
kept: Our server stores none of it: it only reuses the answer to an identical request, from memory, for five minutes. Your household stays in this browser.
offPlan: With the model off, the plan is made in this browser with fixed wording, and nothing about your household leaves it.
offNotice: With the model off, the notice is made in this browser with fixed wording, in English and, where fixed Hindi text covers it, Hindi.
offCompare: With the model off, both plans are made in this browser with fixed wording, and nothing about your household leaves it.
offIntake: The model is off for this browser, so a description cannot be read. Fill the form by hand, or turn the model on.
offAsk: Questions are answered with the model, which is off for this browser. Turning it on also words the plan.
madeHere: Made in this browser with fixed wording, because the model is off for this browser. Nothing about your household left it.

state.on: The model is on for this browser.
state.off: The model is off for this browser.

notChosen: No choice made yet. The app asks before anything first goes to the model.
